title: Basis part of differentials of a separably generated field extension
statement: Let K/k be a field extension [def-pc-field-extension], finitely generated as a field and separable [def-weil-pbc-separable-field-extension]. Let x : Fin r → K be a transcendence basis [def-weil-pbc-transcendence-basis] with K separable algebraic over F = k(x_i) [def-weil-pbc-separable-algebraic-extension]. Then the vectors D(x_i) in the Kähler differentials Ω[K/k] [def-weil-pbc-kahler-differentials] form a K-module basis indexed by Fin r.

source.place: Algebra, proof of Lemma Tag 031W (lemma-derivative-zero-pth-power, algebra.tex lines 44188-44208: 'Omega_{K/k} = oplus K dx_i since k(x_1,...,x_r) subset K is finite separable (computation omitted)'), the fact used without reference in the proof of Lemma Tag 00TV (lemma-separable-smooth, line 38765: 'since kappa is separable over k we have dim Omega_{kappa/k} = trdeg_k(kappa)'); tags verified in stacks-project/tags/tags

proof.text: Put P = k[X_i], A = Algebra.adjoin k (range x), and F = IntermediateField.adjoin k (range x). The algebraic independence part of the transcendence-basis hypothesis gives the evaluation isomorphism P ≃ₐ[k] A (AlgebraicIndependent.aevalEquiv). IntermediateField.mem_adjoin_iff_div expresses every element of F as a quotient of elements of A. The inclusion A → F is faithful (Subalgebra.inclusion.faithfulSMul), so IsFractionRing.of_field gives IsFractionRing A F. Transfer it along the evaluation isomorphism using IsFractionRing.of_ringEquiv_left to obtain IsFractionRing P F. Define P → K by evaluation and P → F by the evaluation isomorphism followed by inclusion. Their scalar towers commute by aevalEquiv.commutes and algebraMap_aevalEquiv.

source.place: Algebra, proof of Lemma Tag 031W (lemma-derivative-zero-pth-power), lines 44189-44197, where the purely transcendental field k(x_1,...,x_r) is introduced; the fraction-field identification is expanded from Definition Tag 030E (definition-transcendence) in literature/stacks-project/fields.tex

proof.text: Localization makes P → F formally étale: apply Mathlib Algebra.FormallyEtale.of_isLocalization to nonZeroDivisors P (Mathlib/RingTheory/Etale/Basic.lean:179, Stacks Tag 04EG). The hypothesis hxs supplies Algebra.IsSeparable F K; Mathlib Algebra.FormallyEtale.of_isSeparable F K (Mathlib/RingTheory/Etale/Field.lean:98) makes F → K formally étale, even without finiteness. Compose these using Algebra.FormallyEtale.comp P F K (Etale/Basic.lean:114). No use of hfg or hsep is needed.

source.place: Tag 04EG (lemma-localization-formally-etale); Tag 090W (lemma-characterize-separable-algebraic-field-extensions), with the general separable algebraic formal-etaleness supplied by the proved Mathlib theorem Algebra.FormallyEtale.of_isSeparable

proof.text: Take the polynomial differential basis b = KaehlerDifferential.mvPolynomialBasis k (Fin r), supplied by [lem-weil-pbc-polynomial-ring-kahler-basis]. Scalar-extend it directly from P to K using Module.Basis.baseChange K. Since P → K is formally étale, the canonical isomorphism tensorKaehlerEquivOfFormallyEtale k P K underlying [lem-weil-pbc-separable-algebraic-differentials-base-change] maps this basis to a K-basis of Ω[K/k]. Here the canonical theorem is applied to the composite formally étale map rather than transporting the basis in two stages.

proof.text: For each i, Module.Basis.map_apply and baseChange_apply identify the new basis vector with the image of 1 ⊗ dX_i. The formulas tensorKaehlerEquivOfFormallyEtale_apply, mapBaseChange_tmul, map_D and mvPolynomialBasis_apply identify this image with D k K (aeval x (X i)); MvPolynomial.aeval_X makes it D k K (x i). These formulas apply unchanged for r = 0, with no inhabited-index assumption.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_basis_differentials_of_separating_transcendenceBasis_basis
    {k : Type u} {K : Type v} [Field k] [Field K] [Algebra k K]
    (hfg : (⊤ : IntermediateField k K).FG)
    (hsep : Algebra.IsSeparableExtension k K)
    {r : ℕ} (x : Fin r → K) (hx : IsTranscendenceBasis k x)
    (hxs : Algebra.IsSeparable (IntermediateField.adjoin k (Set.range x)) K) :
    ∃ b : Module.Basis (Fin r) K (KaehlerDifferential k K),
      ∀ i : Fin r, b i = D k K (x i)
